description: SIREN (SEN Integrated Renewable Energy Network Toolkit) is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by Sustainable Energy Now Inc. SIREN uses external datasets to model the potential for renewable energy generation for a geographic region. The approach is to model the data on an hourly basis for a desired year (ignoring leap days, that is, 8,760 hours). Users explore potential location and scale of renewable energy sources (stations, storage, transmission) to meet electricity demand. Coverage: user-defined regions (as stated on the fact sheet). The fact sheet classes it as: Electricity System Model,. Sectors: Electricity,. Resolution: time Hour, geography Individual power stations. Data availability is given as "some". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is AGPL-3.0 (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
